newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iran buys 100,000 tonnes optional barley - traders.
newsitem.headline: Iran buys 100,000 tonnes optional barley - traders.

text.p: Iran has bought 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley at prices ranging from $129 to $129.50 per tonne, Fob, European grain traders said on Wednesday.
The barley is for shipment in April, they said.
The barley is likely to come from the European Union, Canada and Australia, traders said.
The purchase was in a tender this week.

Trade sources said up to 50,000 tonnes of the barley released by the EU last Thursday could be destined for Iran, although it was unclear whether that was in anticipation of this week's purchase or to cover previous business.
The EU last week granted export licences for 75,000 tonnes of free market barley at a maximum rebate of 27.93 Ecus a tonne.
